name: Bedrock Cheek
description: Two hatchets are held low and apart like a hawk's lowered wings, covering both sides of the body.

name: Bitedict
description: One hatchet chops high while the other follows low, the pair striking as a hawk's two talons.

name: Heelsolace
description: Both feet land together after a short hop forward, so the pair of hatchets arrive level.

name: Beardcrown
description: Qi fills both edges at once and a crossing cut shears through the guard in a scissor pattern.

name: Thrall Toe
description: Both beards close on the opponent's weapon arm, one above the elbow and one below the wrist.

name: Squall Handlenub
description: The hatchets sweep outward together like opening wings and throw a heavy blow wide of the user.

name: Choral Chock
description: Strokes alternate between the two hatchets in a falling rhythm that wears the opponent's guard down.

name: Prismhelve
description: Both hatchets drop on one point of a shield or breastplate, and the combined blow drives through it.

name: Illustrious Eye
description: A flash across the gap places both hatchets on either side of the opponent in a single severing cross.

name: Peerless Quenched Poll
description: The school's signature stroke: both hatchets descend in a crossing X, and the gathered qi decides how deeply it cuts.

name: Revered Beard
description: The hatchet hangs at the hip and the free hand holds up the court's open palm, a calm guard that invites the first move.

name: Pollbanner
description: A chop parts the opponent's guard like a stone parting a stream, one half to each side.

name: Cheekboon
description: A flat-footed step on a gravel bar, shifting weight so slowly that the footing is never disturbed.

name: Helvedecree
description: Qi divides along the edge in two paths so the cut seems to reach the opponent by both sides.

name: Peal Eye
description: The hatchet circles a blade in a small eddy, spinning its force aside and returning to centre.

name: Unbending Billet
description: The beard catches the opponent's arm and draws it backward against its own advance like a back current.

name: Venomkerf
description: A sharp rap on the weapon wrist knocks the blade toward the bank of the opponent's own side.

name: Orchestral Fell
description: Two streams of strokes, one high and one low, run beside each other until they join in a single finishing cut.

name: Magmapoll
description: After a gathering breath, a broad sweep sends qi forking out to both sides of the user's front.

name: Exalted Cheek
description: Two currents of the qi field meet at the edge as at a confluence and drive through the guard as one.

name: Heroic Thunderclap Toe
description: The court's signature: one wide circling cut divides the opponent's attack in two and breaks their rhythm.

name: Sacrosanct Haftswell
description: The hatchet hangs at the side with the grip relaxed, the way the lineage's oldest students stand.

name: Heeldecree
description: A low chop at the opponent's lead leg, as if cutting a furrow into the floor of a basin.

name: Windborne Toe
description: Short heavy steps keep the user steady where the ground is soft and clinging.

name: Bitpledge
description: A rap that lands in stages, wrist then forearm then elbow, jars the opponent's arm step by step.

name: Chockbanner
description: Qi rises through the stroke in steps, so each part of the cut bites deeper than the last.

name: Deluge Poll
description: A parry passed down unchanged by generations of students, the head turning a blade off in one clean arc.

name: Rending Beard
description: The beard hooks the ankle from below and drags the opponent's foot along the ground.

name: Spectral Fell
description: Stepping down and back as if descending a basin's slope, the user lures the opponent after them.

name: Symphonic Eye
description: Each stroke recalls the one the master taught before it, running the whole lineage's pattern in unbroken order.

name: Radiance Billet
description: A gathered stroke at the rim of a shield or helm splits it along its seam.

name: Gallant Kerf
description: Qi carries the user the last stride in a flash, and the edge falls without a sound.

name: Majestic Steel Heel
description: The lineage's signature: a single deflecting cut taught from master to student, its depth set by the student's qi.

name: Devout Cheek
description: The doctrine's first posture: hatchet upright at the sternum, shoulders square, chin level.

name: Billetedict
description: A straight overhead chop, as clean and flat as the line of the horizon.

name: Pollgrace
description: The measured pace of a courtyard walk, held even while the hatchet stays level.

name: Intrepid Splinter
description: Qi is drawn in a straight line from the heel to the edge, and the cut follows it faithfully.

name: Pall Handlenub
description: A turning parry that presents the flat of the head to the blow and spins it clear.

name: Entropy Eye
description: The beard catches the opponent's arm at the exact moment the doctrine says it will be extended.

name: Harmonious Helve
description: Cut, hook and turn follow in the strict order of the court's teaching, leaving no gap for reply.

name: Quenched Axehew
description: One stroke, placed with the exactness the doctrine demands, splits a post, a haft or a raised arm.

name: Fearless Toe
description: After a still moment, the stroke falls as a verdict and seals the opponent's guard shut.

name: Dauntless Pulsar Fell
description: The court's signature: a single stroke delivered as a decree, with qi gathered in proportion to the student's realm.

name: Steel Eye
description: The user stands with one arm raised like a hawk and one low like a river, the hatchet between.

name: Chocktriumph
description: A diving chop is followed immediately by a flowing sideways draw of the head.

name: Silken Bit
description: A light skimming step over uneven ground lets the user glide as a hawk skims water.

name: Polldecree
description: Qi dives with the edge and then flows along the wound, deepening it as it goes.

name: Parity Cheek
description: The parry meets a blade side-on, like one current crossing another, and sets it adrift.

name: Subjugating Heel
description: The beard seizes like a talon and a qi-fed drag pulls the opponent down like an undertow.

name: Squallkerf
description: A backward leap lifted by qi in the legs, as a hawk rises on warm air, clears the opponent's reach.

name: Grand Beard
description: A diving cut, a pulling hook and a rising backhand run together as a hawk's single sweep over water.

name: Solarbit
description: A wide gathered sweep sends the qi field over the whole front of the user like a hawk's shadow.

name: Heroic Beard
description: In a flash the user crosses the gap low over the ground and cuts from the opponent's rear quarter.

name: Majestic Billet
description: The school's signature: a high leap and a long descending cut that carries the user's whole field down the edge.

name: Undefiled Beard
description: One hand guards the core while the hatchet hand rides the second track, ready to cut or parry.

name: Chockverdict
description: A chop along the inner track keeps the elbow tight and the cut close to the body.

name: Kernel Poll
description: A rap along the outer track strikes the opponent's weapon from a wide angle and spins it away.

name: Heelvoyage
description: Each stride begins low in the body, near the core, and arrives with the shoulders still level.

name: Cheekedict
description: The formed Core feeds qi straight to the edge along one track while the other carries the cut.

name: Unwavering Handlenub
description: The two tracks are woven across each other, and the blow is lost in the crossing.

name: Tyrannous Fell
description: The beard hooks and the strength of the Core twists, wrenching the held limb out of its socket's line.

name: Ethereal Billet
description: One flow of qi lightens the legs while the other keeps the hatchet ready, and the user draws away unhurried.

name: Resonant Chock
description: Cuts on the inner track and hooks on the outer follow in unbroken alternation until the guard fails.

name: Prism Splinter
description: A gathered cleave drives heat from the Core through the edge into a single point of the guard.

name: Gallant Bit
description: Both tracks flash together and the user is past the opponent's guard with the hatchet already falling.

name: Imperial Heel
description: The doctrine's signature: both tracks of the Core meet in one descending stroke whose force the student's realm sets.

name: Consecrated Poll
description: The hatchet hangs by the thigh, unmoving, the posture of one who has sworn to the wind.

name: Pollcrown
description: A chop taken on the inward breath, light in the arm and heavy at the head.

name: Eyegrace
description: A skipping step with the wind behind, covering more ground than its size suggests.

name: Helveverdict
description: Qi follows the wind's line along the arm and the cut lands as a sworn stroke should.

name: Pall Beard
description: The parry takes the blow on the sheltered side and slides it past into the open air.

name: Millstone Cheek
description: The beard hooks as a gust pushes from behind, adding the wind's push to the pull.

name: Wraithlike Toe
description: Qi lets the user hop backward on the wind and land where the opponent's reach ends.

name: Resonant Fell
description: Cut, hook, shove and cut follow the rising and falling pulse of a gale, each blow sworn to the next.

name: Vacuum Bit
description: A stroke aimed at a single seam of the guard opens it like wind shearing a loose plank.

name: Triumphant Beard
description: The user flashes past the opponent like a passing gust and the edge cuts as it goes by.

name: Splendid Billet
description: The wind academies' signature: the whole gathered gale falls down the edge in one stroke, its force set by the student's realm.

name: Venerable Eye
description: Planted on open ground with the hatchet held across the body, the user keeps faith with the oath of the plain.

name: Beardbanner
description: A chop thrown from a firm stance rooted in the plateau, never reaching beyond the balance.

name: Poll Voyage
description: A long, flat stride across level ground, covering distance without a rise or fall.

name: Heelcrown
description: Qi gathered from the planted feet rises through the body into one level, cutting stroke.

name: Peal Poll
description: The edge itself turns the blow, held firm as an oath that cannot be bent.

name: Ruling Bit
description: The beard drags the opponent's arm across the open ground and holds it there.

name: Choral Helve
description: Each step and cut follows one promise to the next across the open ground until the opponent yields.

name: Steel Toe
description: After a long breath on the plain, the cleave falls as sworn and splits a raised guard.

name: Sigilkerf
description: The user binds the opponent to the ground with the field and cuts through the closed guard.

name: Famed Fell
description: The school's signature: one stroke sworn on the plateau, set by the student's realm and delivered without wavering.

name: Inviolate Cheek
description: The user fixes a bearing before the first move and keeps the guard aligned to it.

name: Bitverdict
description: The chop is aimed along a bearing set before the arm even rises.

name: Despotic Beard
description: A rap to the weapon hand tests the opponent's line and shows the bearing to take.

name: Pollsolace
description: Feet follow the bearing exactly, each step falling on the same straight line.

name: Heelbanner
description: With the bearing set, qi runs the length of the arm and the cut lands true.

name: Squall Toe
description: A parry that takes a new bearing from the blow itself and turns it neatly aside.

name: Crushing Eye
description: The beard hooks and pulls the opponent onto the user's own bearing, away from theirs.

name: Skyborne Helve
description: Withdrawing on one bearing and resetting on another, the user returns to the fight from a new line.

name: Grand Poll
description: One bearing is taken, three strokes follow along it, and the line ends exactly at the opponent's guard.

name: Quenched Kerf
description: A gathered cleave drives along the bearing and pierces the single point the user has marked.

name: Vigorbit
description: Qi snaps the user along the bearing in a flash and the cut lands on the marked point.

name: Paramount Inferno Chock
description: The school's signature: a stroke whose bearing is taken in stillness and released at once, with force set by the student's realm.

name: Immaculate Poll
description: The hatchet is held before the chest like an open charter, quiet but binding on all who approach.

name: Beardtriumph
description: A plain chop that follows the first line of the charter, direct and with no embellishment.

name: Evanescent Cheek
description: The steady marching step of a plateau walker, keeping the hatchet level over long ground.

name: Toeedict
description: Qi follows the charter's line from heel to edge and the cut lands with measured weight.

name: Deluge Eye
description: A parry set down like a clause, turning one specific blow from one specific side.

name: Peal Billet
description: The beard catches the opponent's weapon arm and binds it to the terms of the exchange.

name: Heelboon
description: A step back that keeps within the charter's bounds and never abandons the guard.

name: Orchestral Bit
description: Cut, hook, parry and cut are taken in the written order of the charter's chapters.

name: Pulsar Poll
description: A cleave released after a held breath breaks the terms of the opponent's guard and splits it.

name: Intrepid Helve
description: With one flash across the plateau, the user cuts as the charter's last clause is read.

name: Illustrious Cheek
description: The charter's signature: one descending cut sealed with the school's authority, its force set by the student's realm.

name: Stately Beard
description: On a cliff's lip the hatchet is held low and the knees bent, so the wind cannot upset the stance.

name: Eyedecree
description: A chop thrown outward over the drop, driving the opponent's guard toward the edge.

name: Spectral Poll
description: A running step along a narrow ridge, the arms out and the weight low.

name: Felltriumph
description: Qi is thrown across the edge of the footing and the cut arrives with the weight of a falling gust.

name: Parity Toe
description: The parry uses the slope of the ridge, letting the blow slide off down the grade.

name: Thrall Heel
description: The beard hooks the opponent's belt and drags them toward the drop, with the user's own feet braced.

name: Symphonic Billet
description: Cut, shove and hook follow in order along the rim, each pushing the opponent nearer the brink.

name: Mighty Handlenub
description: A single sweep after a gathering pause sends the qi field out over the drop in front of the user.

name: Noble Bit
description: The user flashes across the rim as a wind does and the edge cuts from the unguarded side.

name: Peerless Cheek
description: The school's signature: the field passes over the edge of the hatchet like wind over a cliff and cuts as it goes.

name: Sainted Heel
description: The user stands with weight even and the hatchet low, fixing a bearing that will hold through the whole fight.

name: Eyecrown
description: A chop that extends along the full length of the arm and the bearing together.

name: Tyrannous Bit
description: A heavy unhurried rap, like a slow wind leaning on a door, unsettles the opponent's grip.

name: Twilit Toe
description: A long step along a distant bearing that the eyes marked at the start of the exchange.

name: Fellverdict
description: The Core holds one steady stream of qi and the cut draws on it without any waver.

name: Pall Toe
description: A parry made on the long bearing turns a blow without disturbing the user's line.

name: Savage Heel
description: The beard reaches at the farthest point of the arm and pulls the opponent onto the user's bearing.

name: Silken Cheek
description: Retreating slowly along the same bearing, the user gives ground without breaking the line.

name: Harmonious Axehew
description: One long bearing carries a chain of cuts and hooks from the first exchange to the last.

name: Nucleus Chock
description: A gathered cleave drives the Core's steady qi into the guard like a long wind into a sail.

name: Exalted Billet
description: A flash along the far bearing places the user on the opponent's flank and the edge falls there.

name: Valiant Haemal Toe
description: The doctrine's signature: a single stroke held on the long bearing and released as one descent, with force set by the student's realm.
